outcome: Morbidity (subsequent morbidity, cerebrovascular events, cardiac diseases, major cardiovascular events)
cohort: The study included 235 women who experienced a maternal stroke in Finland between 1987-2016 and survived the first year after the event, compared to 694 matched stroke-free controls.
finding: Maternal stroke survivors experienced higher long-term mortality and increased cardiovascular morbidity compared to controls, yet the majority recovered well in daily activities and most were working by the end of the follow-up.
followup_time: Median 17.5 years for mortality and 11.8 years for vocational status and morbidity
